name: 401-longprefill-qwen2-1.5b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1. One engine on one GPU.
architecture: GPTBigCodeForCausalLM, 20 layers, 12 heads, head_dim 64, hidden 768, FFN 3072, learned absolute position embeddings with n_positions 8192, vocab 49152, fp16, 164M params = 0.33 GB. The checkpoint is multi-query; this engine generation has no MQA path and expands the packed KV projections to full MHA at load time, so 142M of non-embedding parameters take part in the forward pass.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=1, bounded at 500 requests / 2400 s safety, warmup the first 20% by completion. Budget roughly 0.7 s per request plus model load.
workload: guidellm synthetic_text, one turn, prompt fixed at 8064 tokens (min = max) and output fixed at 100 tokens (min = max), greedy (temperature 0.0) with ignore_eos, request_format plain.
purpose: A code completion helper taking 8,000-token repository contexts and returning 100-token suggestions, one request at a time on a single GPU.
launch:
# Engine configuration for 401-longprefill-qwen2-1.5b-1gpu, in `vllm serve --config` form.
#
# The engine that runs is the 0.1.2-generation source tree this item pins, NOT a
# later wheel. Its `EngineArgs` is a small dataclass and an unknown key is a TypeError at engine
# construction, so ONLY these keys exist:
#   model tokenizer tokenizer-mode trust-remote-code download-dir use-np-weights
#   use-dummy-weights dtype seed worker-use-ray pipeline-parallel-size tensor-parallel-size
#   block-size swap-space gpu-memory-utilization max-num-batched-tokens max-num-seqs
#   disable-log-stats  (+ engine-use-ray, disable-log-requests on the async subclass)
# There is no `max-model-len`, no `rope-scaling`, no `enable-prefix-caching` and no
# `enable-chunked-prefill` at this generation. Naming any of them raises at engine
# construction and every request errors before generation.
# Every key must be top-level and every value must stay on ONE line -- the reader skips
# indented lines.

model: bigcode/tiny_starcoder_py
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: float16

# The context ceiling is the model's, not a flag: this generation computes
# max_seq_len = min(max-num-batched-tokens, hf_config.max_position_embeddings) and DROPS any
# prompt at or above it. tiny_starcoder_py declares n_positions 8192, which is the largest
# window any checkpoint this engine's registry can load actually reaches, so 8192 is the whole
# window; setting max-num-batched-tokens to it lets one prompt be admitted whole in a single
# scheduler step instead of being held back by the 2560-token default.
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192

# The engine's own defaults, written out so a later default cannot drift them.
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
block-size: 16
max-num-seqs: 256
swap-space: 4
seed: 0

# Both are pure logging on the engine thread, and one of them is expensive here: with request
# logging on, this generation formats the whole prompt string AND the entire prompt-token-id
# list into one log line per request. That is host work inside the client's wait that has
# nothing to do with serving.
disable-log-requests: true
disable-log-stats: true
